scope: Both-brand failure and acceptance evidence. October 22–23 Duroflex all-asset/PDP runs plus all observed Sleepyhead historical runs from October 13–22. Cancellation, legacy evidence and current regression coverage remain distinct.

cases.title: Image upload disconnects before a response
cases.causeOrLimitation: Multipart reference transfer failed with socket loss; the network hop responsible was not established. CDN staging replaces bulk upload in paid requests.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Ten varied complete live scenarios per affected route, with recorded responses and unchanged source bytes.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Planning and review connections fail
cases.causeOrLimitation: Concepts, art, reconciliation and review also lost connections; replacing image uploads does not fix these stages.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Stage-specific interruption/restart proofs and complete reviewed outputs; do not resend ambiguous paid requests.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Explicit HTTP 500 and retryable provider errors
cases.causeOrLimitation: A recorded explicit service error permits one separately reserved recovery. External service errors remain possible.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Verify bounded recovery live; persistent errors must stop and preserve every attempt.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Retry storms and queue exhaustion
cases.causeOrLimitation: Recovery previously lacked persisted Retry-After pacing; admission and cancellation now have bounded queues.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Distributed admission/fairness and live load evidence remain separate from process-local tests.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Lost responses leave unknown charges
cases.causeOrLimitation: A reservation without a saved response is an ambiguous outcome, not a zero charge or confirmed provider failure.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Reconcile provider billing while preserving request identity, usage and historical reservations.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Policy-version mismatch disabled readability checks
cases.causeOrLimitation: Readers did not recognise a newer supported policy pin.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Maintain compatibility tests for every version; new artwork still needs actual viewing-size checks.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Supporting copy missing from capacity totals
cases.causeOrLimitation: Only body text was counted, allowing supporting copy to bypass capacity assessment.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Exercise all supported roles and languages; render readability remains distinct.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Landscape capacity too generous
cases.causeOrLimitation: Capacity inherited tall-tile assumptions rather than actual displayed height.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Prove concise copy and sufficient text area in each landscape route.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: A+ copy cannot fit proposed layout
cases.causeOrLimitation: Copy and layout negotiation can produce conflicting readability constraints.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: A complete passing small-preview A+ result with required qualifiers retained.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: LinkedIn fit revision lengthened copy
cases.causeOrLimitation: Upstream revision did not enforce non-increasing embedded word count.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Successful live recovery after this guard, not merely rejecting an overlong revision.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: LinkedIn landscape small supporting copy and CTA
cases.causeOrLimitation: Saved reviewers report insufficient viewing-size legibility; accurate transcription is insufficient.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Passing rendered landscape pair at intended viewing size, with human comparison.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Product markings, fabric and geometry drift
cases.causeOrLimitation: Generated product identity can differ from exact SKU references despite receiving valid source images.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Compare each final hash against the selected SKU; preserve defects and uncertain findings.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Suspected logo-clipping false positive
cases.causeOrLimitation: Saved reviewer finding and manual spot check disagree; root cause is not adjudicated.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Human-labelled comparison of exact artwork and approved logo, measuring false positives and misses.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Desktop banner judged at phone width
cases.causeOrLimitation: Desktop and mobile preview context were conflated; separate assumptions now exist.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Actual host component dimensions, cropping and breakpoints must still be tested.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Banner preview and generation dimensions disagree
cases.causeOrLimitation: Display label did not match the 1920 by 640 connected route.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Verify catalogue, brief, request, preview and downloaded bytes for all variants.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: PDP feature and dimension cards classified as photography
cases.causeOrLimitation: Role classification omitted information-card reading treatment.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Full pack measurement labels must pass intended-size inspection.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: PDP planning fails on optional body copy
cases.causeOrLimitation: Generated optional body conflicts with a zero-body reading policy; required qualifiers cannot simply be dropped.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Exercise exact locked wording, empty photo decks and required qualifiers in live plans.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Feed square and portrait have no passing pair
cases.causeOrLimitation: Latest batch saved images but both formats had zero passing options for differing review reasons.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Complete each exact ratio with independently reviewed results; do not borrow another ratio's pass.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Story has only one saved option
cases.causeOrLimitation: One generation failed after the other option succeeded.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Two actual saved and reviewed options, preserving the failed attempt and unknown charge.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: WhatsApp, desktop hero and banner lack a passing pair
cases.causeOrLimitation: Two images are not two passes; latest batch has one passing option in these routes.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Pass both final hashes for each exact route; earlier banner success does not close later failure.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Saved images lack complete verification
cases.causeOrLimitation: Transport/schema uncertainty or missing evidence leaves some outputs unable to verify.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Complete hash-bound checks without converting unknown to pass or resetting correction limits.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Full twelve-image pack initially absent
cases.causeOrLimitation: Flat recipe/count caps lacked ordered parent-child planning and whole-set acceptance; the route is now implemented.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: All 24 final images and both whole-set reviews must pass; current 24 saved images are not a passing pack.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Large planning handoff and resume boundaries
cases.causeOrLimitation: A single large planning response could not safely express and resume all placements.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Hash-bound batch reuse, complete merged validation and no duplicate paid dispatch.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Whole-gallery review exceeds attachment capacity
cases.causeOrLimitation: Twelve masters plus previews exceed one supported image batch.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Inspect every master/preview and preserve any fail or unknown through final overview.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Strategist blocked on unused optional brand facts
cases.causeOrLimitation: Dependency assessment included unrelated facts rather than claims used by the selected direction.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Selected unsupported claims still block; unrelated optional gaps must not stop valid work.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: PDP fact extraction and gallery coverage too narrow
cases.causeOrLimitation: The ordinary audit/gallery subset omitted evidence needed by the complete pack.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Include exact-SKU saved evidence within context limits; reject foreign product or brand references.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Atomic service claims conflate coverage and unknown duration
cases.causeOrLimitation: A supported warranty coverage statement was entangled with unsupported service duration.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Keep supported coverage distinct, preserve qualifiers and leave unknown duration unresolved.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Planner confuses photo evidence with textual proof
cases.causeOrLimitation: A text-led warranty card was assessed as though its photograph must prove service terms or an excluded cutaway.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Validate actual proposed pixels separately from cited wording; live model judgment can still err.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Global PDP plan assigned the wrong task owner and scope
cases.causeOrLimitation: Global creative-director planning used a per-output art task kind; old handoff identities could conflict.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Dedicated task kind and versioned resumed handoff; saved plan reuse without duplicate dispatch.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Full pack inherited ordinary 45-minute deadline
cases.causeOrLimitation: Twenty-four outputs plus review exceeded the ordinary allowance; a bounded 120-minute pack window was added.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Deadline extension is not a speed fix; retain financial limits and benchmark actual completion time.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Gallery selection omitted mandatory identity anchor
cases.causeOrLimitation: Art chose valid gallery views but the compiler did not always attach the designated SKU identity source.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Compiler must attach hash-verified anchor; missing or changed bytes must block before paid dispatch.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Undispatched reference-blocked outputs consumed workflow state
cases.causeOrLimitation: Placeholder failure records made a corrected mechanical preflight appear to require a new correction cycle.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Only exact zero-dispatch reference omissions qualify; preserve historical records and deny ambiguous or already-rendered units.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Every progress read revalidates growing journal
cases.causeOrLimitation: Full-prefix validation became expensive; matching validated prefixes are cached, but every read still reads history bytes and rebuilds progress.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Incremental snapshots and large-job benchmarks; validate corruption, cache eviction and concurrent changes.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Photo-only review emits empty expected wording
cases.causeOrLimitation: Not-applicable copy check produced an empty string rejected by its own evidence schema.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: No-copy review must remain schema-valid while product markings are checked separately.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Saved image cannot complete a previously timed-out generation task
cases.causeOrLimitation: Terminal task status prevented completion and subsequent review despite durable saved pixels.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Versioned task attempt, exact saved-byte reuse, no extra image call and idempotent subsequent resume.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Pair batching leaves worker capacity idle
cases.causeOrLimitation: Next output batch waited for both peers rather than one free slot.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Work-conserving bounded scheduling with same-concept carousel anchor dependencies; clean live latency remains unmeasured.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: All-slot planning delays first image
cases.causeOrLimitation: Full plan/copy/art/reconciliation barriers delay rendering; interrupted run took 36.9 minutes to first image.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Per-slot durable readiness and shared bounded planning queue, then clean live timing evidence.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Generic image and format ceilings block valid packs
cases.causeOrLimitation: Independent caps existed in creation, editor, readiness and preview; they were removed in favour of pack contracts.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Maintain output-count-derived budgets, exact contracts and resource limits; no unlimited dispatch.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Website certifications blocked despite client approval
cases.causeOrLimitation: New Duroflex jobs now pin explicit official-website certification approval; it is not independent verification.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Exact same-source quote and SKU qualifiers; no forged approval, medical-claim promotion or automatic Sleepyhead approval.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Previous brand remains clickable during switch
cases.causeOrLimitation: Old DOM survived asynchronous cache restoration.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Both directions with delayed cache reads and late-response guards; never carry brand content across scopes.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Reload or return loses scroll and filters
cases.causeOrLimitation: Background refresh saved temporary zero before pending scroll restoration.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Back, reload, breadcrumbs, exact card and scoped filters under delayed refresh.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Stale completed status redirects away from running or failed job
cases.causeOrLimitation: Cached completion was used before fresh status confirmation.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Fresh status per Progress visit, reconnect and same-document navigation for both brands.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Artwork disappears at narrow viewport
cases.causeOrLimitation: Review grid retained a minimum rationale width and squeezed image column.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Five viewport sizes, wrapping toolbar and no horizontal overflow.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Home laptop-fold test fails in broad run but passes alone
cases.causeOrLimitation: Observed inconsistent layout assertion; exact timing/layout cause is not established.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Repeated isolated and full-suite execution; retain failure rather than marking all tests green.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Older navigation assertions conflict with requested UI
cases.causeOrLimitation: Some old expectations referenced removed naming/help/summary controls; other failures were real races.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Classify each original assertion; updating an obsolete expectation must not erase a real defect.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Feed portrait and LinkedIn ratio routes missing
cases.causeOrLimitation: Exact route mappings were later connected; catalogue discovery and rendered quality are separate.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Verify every requested ratio through selection, generation, review and downloaded bytes.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: PMax and YouTube Community delivery
cases.causeOrLimitation: Scope requires specific image sets and native fields; generic social images cannot establish complete delivery.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Freeze channel contract and prove all dimensions, fields and export paths.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Website responsive delivery and landing modules
cases.causeOrLimitation: Standalone banners do not prove actual desktop/mobile crop, container or complete handoff.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Real host component, breakpoint/crop checks, alt text and required modules.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Listing sets, Premium A+ and comparison charts
cases.causeOrLimitation: Standard raster-module support does not prove full marketplace templates, eligibility or sourced comparisons.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Selected marketplace contract, full slot set and actual preview acceptance.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Print and retail production
cases.causeOrLimitation: Digital artwork or raster PDF cannot prove physical production readiness.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Vendor size/template, actual proof, colour/substrate and installed reading-distance acceptance.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Email, RCS and push delivery
cases.causeOrLimitation: Channel field/HTML handoffs and client previews are distinct from a saved WhatsApp image.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Exercise each creation route, required native fields, links, image-off and actual client preview.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: PR and editable documents
cases.causeOrLimitation: Spec coverage and raster images do not establish source-reviewed native documents.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Fact sheets, Q&A, releases, demo/training/sales/CX outputs with pagination and editable export acceptance.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Regional GT and COCO catalogues
cases.causeOrLimitation: Full range, regional selection and print/digital/language editions need their own contracts.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Product coverage, order, price/source consistency, language and actual document exports.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Resize, localisation and personalised versions
cases.causeOrLimitation: Changing pixels or language cannot inherit original approval or silently modify source truths.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Exact child versions, localised copy checks, layout and brand/SKU/store scope, exports.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Ten complete live scenarios per affected route outstanding
cases.causeOrLimitation: Offline regressions, repeated transfers and recorded replays are different evidence classes.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: A frozen varied live matrix with all failures in denominator; reviewed complete outputs per scenario.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Reviewer false flags and missed defects unmeasured
cases.causeOrLimitation: Model confidence and checks do not substitute for human adjudication of exact saved artwork.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Label fixed image/reference pairs; compute disagreement by criterion and retain uncertain cases.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Process-local queues and caches are not distributed coordination
cases.causeOrLimitation: Single-process admission does not provide cross-worker locks, durable shared queue fairness or global rate limits.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Multi-worker concurrency/crash tests and shared idempotency/admission coordination.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Regression coverage is not a guarantee of zero recurrence.

cases.title: Activity journal append reports busy
cases.causeOrLimitation: Saved job creative-3bb5d5b8-339f-41fc-b791-60bd157bfb9f stopped with an append-lock busy error. The conflicting writer and safe retry outcome are not yet established.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Reproduce concurrent writers against the exact job callback, verify durable idempotent retry and preserve lock ownership.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Protective stops must remain visible; their occurrence is not automatically a software defect.

cases.title: Input-token counting unavailable before generation
cases.causeOrLimitation: Two saved attempts were blocked because context counting was unavailable. Blocking is intentional; availability and safe retry still need evidence.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Restore or bound counting-service recovery without skipping context checks; prove no generation dispatch or charge reservation on failed count.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Protective stops must remain visible; their occurrence is not automatically a software defect.

cases.title: Brief and governing placement disagree
cases.causeOrLimitation: Saved request asks for a blog graphic while its governing placement is LinkedIn/Facebook landscape. The strategist requested clarification.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Trace the selected route into the brief, eliminate unintended mappings and preserve a clear conflict when user requirements disagree.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Protective stops must remain visible; their occurrence is not automatically a software defect.

cases.title: Required complete message conflicts with exact copy fields
cases.causeOrLimitation: Saved reconciliation found that the required message in text-1 conflicted with the supplied four-field copy set. Wording was not silently changed.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Freeze one source of exact required wording across brief, copy and art; identify whether the conflict originated in input or a generated handoff.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Protective stops must remain visible; their occurrence is not automatically a software defect.

cases.title: Rendered exact wording differs from locked copy
cases.causeOrLimitation: Saved output observations include exact-required-copy failures or uncertainty. A valid copy contract does not guarantee correct rendered spelling, symbols or qualifiers.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Compare locked wording and final pixels field by field; preserve allowable comparison normalisation without rewriting observations.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Recorded findings require adjudication; passing contract tests is not a new artwork pass.

cases.title: Campaign logo identity fails or remains uncertain
cases.causeOrLimitation: Saved outputs include logo-identity findings beyond the singled-out clipping dispute. A mandatory reference does not prove accurate rendered logo geometry or wording.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Inspect approved logo and exact output hash; distinguish actual artwork defect from uncertain review.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Recorded findings require adjudication; passing contract tests is not a new artwork pass.

cases.title: Mandatory brand-rule compliance cannot be established
cases.causeOrLimitation: Several saved reviews report unknown mandatory-brand-rules, including absent explicit execution requirements or draft/coverage limitations. Unknown is not a visual failure or a pass.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Trace applicable supplied rules and authority into the review; distinguish true absence/not-applicability from missing evidence without inventing approval.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Recorded findings require adjudication; passing contract tests is not a new artwork pass.

cases.title: Creative quality confidence insufficient after critical checks
cases.causeOrLimitation: Some outputs clear critical checks but remain unable to verify because quality assessment confidence is insufficient. This is separate from transport and copy-fit failure.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Human-calibrate quality criteria on fixed outputs; complete the required evidence without lowering thresholds just to close a run.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Recorded findings require adjudication; passing contract tests is not a new artwork pass.

cases.title: Saved Sleepyhead strategy blocked on font availability/licensing
cases.causeOrLimitation: A Sleepyhead Bubbles run requested production font availability/licensing evidence before rendering. The saved stop is real; a current route-specific recovery has not been proven.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Determine whether the dependency is applicable to the selected execution, use only that brand’s authorised font evidence, and prove a successful same-SKU handoff.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Historical source/placement assumptions must be assessed under their original policy; no current success is inferred.

cases.title: Saved Sleepyhead mattress variant dimensions could not be substantiated
cases.causeOrLimitation: Napster Mini and Sense Ortho attempts requested official exact-variant dimension evidence. Later retries remain distinct and do not erase these source-contract stops.
cases.closureEvidenceRequired: Bind each Sleepyhead variant to its own official saved specification and units; verify dimensions reach strategy/copy/review without borrowing Duroflex facts.
cases.recurrenceStatement: Historical source/placement assumptions must be assessed under their original policy; no current success is inferred.
